journeys.title: The Cast Prelude
journeys.description:
What makes a Signature Journey different from a full Journey is the curation — each song edited and orchestrated specifically for the three-stage experience. The depth of attention here is that of a featured release.
More Signature Journeys are coming.
journeys.framingLine: Eight songs from our Signature Series.

journeys.title: The Warm Front
journeys.description: Vintage swing and golden-era jazz drawn from 1930s and 40s Broadway, Big Band, and Neo Urban Swing.
journeys.framingLine: Eight songs for the moments that deserve a little warmth.

journeys.title: The Daybreak Shuffle
journeys.description: Big Band Swing, Boogie Woogie, and Gypsy Jazz from the 1930s and 40s, built for a morning that is already moving.
journeys.framingLine: Eight songs for mornings with somewhere to be.

journeys.title: The Catalyst Tracks
journeys.description:
The morning you mark a milestone.
The morning you start a trip.
The morning you claim solitude.
The morning you walk into something demanding.
The morning you forgive yesterday and begin again.
Each track features a different member of the Ensemble.
journeys.framingLine: Five songs, each composed for a specific kind of morning.

journeys.title: The Teacher
journeys.framingLine: Eight songs for the people who teach.
journeys.description: Eight songs for the people who teach. Granted, not sold.
